events.body:
## Context

`public/script.js` calls `.json()` without checking `response.ok`; a Slack data failure only goes to `console.error`, so the Slack tab later says "No Slack apps match your filters." A GeoJSON failure leaves the map blank.

## What to do

1. Check `.ok`; show an error panel in the Slack and map views.
2. Keep "no results" for real filtering only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Blocking slack_apps.json in DevTools shows an error, not "no results"
- [ ] A GeoJSON failure shows a map notice

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-panini/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000   # block requests in DevTools
```

---
